resources.string: Coordinated publication cycles, backward-scheduled editorial stages, and calm visibility for your entire society.
Count back from issue deadlines from Call for Papers (-60d) to Publish (0d).
Assign manuscripts to individuals or teams with one-tap status updates.
Track every issue via segmented progress, Gantt timelines, and member charts.
Authorized Admin emails sign in with full Admin controls; all other accounts join as Members.
